images.screen: A · 필터 복원 — dragging a band-pass filter through overlapping voices
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A 1990s forensic audio lab workstation filling the screen, dark bakelite and brushed-metal panels with screws and soft amber lighting. Top-left: an open reel-to-reel deck with spinning brown tape reels, a chunky mechanical counter "0413" and cream piano-key transport buttons. Below it, two warm cream analog VU meters with needles swinging. Center: a large green-black CRT spectrogram with scanlines showing two overlapping voices as glowing harmonic stripes — orange-red for a male voice and teal-cyan for a female voice — plus a hum line and speckled noise; an amber horizontal band-pass selection box is being dragged over the teal harmonics, and a vertical amber playhead sweeps across. Right: an effects rack with LED indicators and knurled knobs, and a big amber readout "명료도 66%". Bottom: a cream paper transcript strip where some Korean words are recovered and others are still blurred black blocks, with a red rubber stamp "복원 중". Case header "사건 07 / 15". Tactile, analog, investigative.

images.screen: B · 모순 발견 — the restored tape breaks the suspect's alibi
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. An evidence corkboard filling the screen, warm brown cork texture under a soft desk lamp. Pinned with red pushpins: a suspect's typed statement on cream paper with the phrase about leaving at 10 p.m. struck through in red, and the restored tape transcript on another sheet with the time "열한 시 사십 분" highlighted in yellow. Red string links the two. A small black oscilloscope-style screen shows a clean teal waveform with one amber-highlighted segment labeled "23:40". A large tilted red double-bordered rubber stamp reads "모순 발견". A pale green lab record card lists the filter chain and a grade "S", and a row of fifteen small case tabs along the bottom shows six solved in black and case seven lit in amber. Case header "사건 07 / 15" in the top bar. Satisfying detective breakthrough moment, crisp readable paper typography. Text constraints: the only visible date is "1994. 03. 18." on the statement; do not show any other year (no 2020s dates), no real-world agency names; the setting is a 1994 analog-era case consistent with image A. Speaker constraint (must match image A, which has one male and one female voice): the restored transcript labels its two speakers only as "남" and "여" (the suspect is 남, the other caller is 여); do not use "남성 A" / "남성 B".
